description: This file defines logging utilities for the Mattermost project, including functions to create and configure loggers for different contexts (console, testing) and a thread-safe buffer implementation for testing purposes.

classes.name: Buffer
classes.description: A thread-safe buffer for logging in unit tests, wrapping a bytes.Buffer with mutex locking.

methods.name: AddWriterTarget
methods.description: Adds an io.Writer target to an existing logger with optional JSON formatting and log levels.

methods.name: CreateConsoleLogger
methods.description: Creates a logger that outputs to stdout with a standard filter and formatting, used in general contexts.

methods.name: CreateConsoleTestLogger
methods.description: Creates a logger for unit tests that outputs to stdout, with cleanup on test completion.

methods.name: CreateTestLogger
methods.description: Creates a logger for unit tests that outputs via t.Log, with cleanup on test completion.
